interface.longDescription: Use when working on Drupal 11 frontend — Twig 3 templates, Single Directory Components (SDC), custom themes generated via Starterkit, *.info.yml / *.libraries.yml, libraries-override and libraries-extend, preprocess hooks, Olivero / Claro / Stark, jQuery removal (core/once, native dialog).
